}}'''Ned Yarman''' was a [[Warder]] who was [[Bonding|bonded]] to [[Sareitha Tomares]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ned Yarman}} He had been bonded to her for less than a year.

He was born in {{ne|978}}, in Andor.

== Appearance ==
He was about 6'3 tall, with blue eyes and shoulder length yellow hair. He had a young face and broad shoulders, and was quite handsome - enough to make women's eyes flutter. He was somewhat boyish in mannerisms.

== Activities ==
At sixteen, he went to the Tower to train with the Warders. He felt lucky to have been chosen, as most of those men were not. [[Birgitte Silverbow|Birgitte]] thought that he was still goggle-eyed over it.

He traveled with Sareitha to [[Andor]]. He escorted her and [[Elayne Trakand]] when they moved through the streets of [[Caemlyn]] to greet the people.

He taught Elayne's bodyguards how to use the sword.

He felt Sareitha die inside the house on Full Moon Street and rushed inside to confront the [[Black Ajah]] Aes Sedai who killed her. He died in the confrontation.
